title: VTC Rooms Community Update — payload
description: Change the details an administrator keeps track of a community-owned room by: its label, its description, its tags. Each member given replaces the stored one; a member absent is unchanged. At least one detail is required (`minProperties` counts `roomId` and `reason`), and `description` and `removeDescription` are mutually exclusive. Nothing here reaches the room, its key holder or its members' credentials. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

label.description: The room's new name. Absent: unchanged.

description.description: The room's new description, replacing any it has. Absent: unchanged.

removeDescription.description: Remove the room's description. Only `true` is meaningful, so only `true` is accepted. A separate member rather than `description: null`, because a nullable optional member makes "unchanged" and "remove" the same value in libraries that map both to one absent option.

tags.description: The room's tags, replacing the whole set. An empty list removes them all. Absent: unchanged.

Response.title: VTC Rooms Community Update — response payload
Response.description: Success response to vtc/rooms/community/update. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/rooms/community/update/0.1#response. The room as it now stands, and whether this request changed it.

changed.description: `false` when every value given already matched what the room had: nothing was written, `detailsUpdatedAt` and `detailsUpdatedBy` did not move, and no change was audited.
